reason: Provides the complete, non-truncated pipeline, worker, provider, persistence, preview and no-publishing contracts required for implementation.
Owns the hard separation between factual evidence and private brand context used by long-form claims.
Owns PostgreSQL/Alembic, typed lineage, short transactions, leases, fingerprints and real integration-test requirements.
Owns typed provider failures, bounded retry, review-required outcomes and unknown-result handling.
Owns model, source, storage and credential redaction for the live generation path.
Owns safe component decomposition, accessibility and the ban on unsafe model-content HTML injection.
Owns TanStack Query server state, bounded polling and avoidance of a second client-side database.
Owns OpenAPI-generated wire types, strict view-model mapping and unsafe HTML boundaries.
Maps the exact existing material, Zhipu, worker, migration, storage and frontend seams selected by the design.
